title: 03 · Company record · Corvane
strengths: The timeline records changes, not just events: 'changed Deal value and 3 other attributes' expands into old → new rows with deltas ('$48,000.00 → $62,500.00 +$14,500.00', 'Nov 14, 2026 → Dec 5, 2026 +21 days', 'Evaluation → Proposal')
Record navigation and counts everywhere: '12 of 214 in Enterprise pipeline' with arrows, tabs with counts (Emails 148, Calls 12, People 17), groups with event counts, 'Show all 24'
The details panel invites input: 'Set parent company…', 'Set renewal date…', one field mid-edit with a cobalt focus ring; the cobalt appears only on links and focus
One typeface (Hanken Grotesk) at three sizes and three weights carries the whole screen; the ⌘K frame is scoped to the record with verb-led actions, grey selection and keycaps
slop_signals: Staged states: an expanded diff, a focused input with a caret ('Tier-2 maker of wing ribs|') and a hovered 'Parent company' row in one frame
Three grey-filled meta chips under the title read heavier than Attio's plain meta row

Very close to Attio's layout and copy patterns ('Set parent company…', 'Show all 24', '12 of 214 in Enterprise pipeline'); structure borrowed, which is allowed, but nothing on the screen is Corvane's own
fixes: Fix the list-membership label: 'Enterprise pipeline since today' contradicts the timeline 'moved this company to Enterprise pipeline' on Oct 6; say 'since Oct 6' or label the stage date
Keep only one live edit state (the focused input) and drop the hover row
Rename Halyard Systems (styles/01 Halyard Analytics), Tessaly (styles/02 Tessaly House), Joanne Okafor and Tomás Herrera (both names reused in other pieces)

references.what: Same record layout: tabs with counts, timeline of attribute changes, right details panel with 'Set …' placeholders; ours is denser and has the diff open
Grouped field diff in the timeline ('You updated 7 fields'); ours adds deltas (+$14,500.00, +21 days)
Average tier: colored overdue pill, yellow note card, green Deal button; ours is clearly above it

fixed: Lists panel: 'Enterprise pipeline · since Oct 6', matching the timeline

One temporary state per frame: main frame keeps the expanded change diff; the hovered Parent company row is gone; the field mid-edit is shot-edit.png (?state=edit); the ⌘K frame stays shot-palette.png

Names: Halyard Systems → Aldermoor Systems, Tessaly Aerostructures → Lathom Aerostructures (lathom-aero.com), Tomás Herrera → Gareth Penhale, Joanne Okafor → Joanne Achterberg, Eitan Varga → Eitan Mizrahi
